purpose: Teach: 伊勢/明日香/日テレ/タール/プラハ/瀬戸/譚/挿絵

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、伊勢、絶対、修学旅行、絶対、行ったの?本気で
lines.en: Riku — did you actually go to Ise for the school trip?
lines.style: Quick, skeptical lean forward. Testing whether he's being honest. The cadence of someone who suspects a half-truth and wants the real story.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のクラスの、本気で、絶対、明日香、絶対、っていう子、絶対、可愛いな、桜
lines.en: Asuka from your class is pretty cute, isn't she, Sakura?
lines.style: Deliberately casual shift in subject. Light, almost teasing delivery. A small smile underneath — testing how she reacts, not trying too hard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、日テレ、絶対、の、絶対、バラエティ、絶対、好きだよね
lines.en: You really do like those variety shows on NTV, don't you?
lines.style: Calling him out, but gently. Amused observation. Slight tilt of the head — she's noticed this pattern about him and finds it endearing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、タール、絶対、舗装、絶対、現場、絶対、見たことある?桜
lines.en: Have you ever actually seen a tar-paving site, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through. Quieter than before. The kind of question that catches him thinking — a real wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、プラハ、絶対、いつか、絶対、行きたいよね
lines.en: You want to go to Prague someday, don't you?
lines.style: Soft certainty. She's said this before and he's noticed. Warm observation, not accusation. A small understanding between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお姉ちゃん、本気で、絶対、瀬戸、絶対、市、絶対、出身だよな、桜
lines.en: Your sister's from Seto, isn't she, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle fact-finding. Low volume, almost conversational. He's asking because he's actually listening, not to prove something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の好きな漫画、本気で、絶対、譚、絶対、ってタイトル、絶対、入ってるよね
lines.en: Your favorite manga titles always have that character 'tan' in them, don't they?
lines.style: Soft observation delivered with no judgment. The tone of someone noticing a pattern in someone they care about. Slight smile at the corner.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のノートの、本気で、絶対、挿絵、絶対、上手いな、桜
lines.en: You're really good at drawing in your notebooks, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct compliment, but understated. Steady eye contact. Not overdoing it — just stating what he's seen, with genuine appreciation underneath.
